svg.text: Technical pitfalls in designs (Reilly's list)
Brand-new problem (it is not)
look for prior art and reuse
This looks easy!
other domains are rich; if accounting or payroll looks trivial you do not
understand it
Building for the present
will it work in three years, with acquisitions or twice the team?
Building for the distant future
'we might need it later' is not enough; avoid over-engineering
Every user just needs to...
with hundreds of users, human workflow changes will be done wrong; design for it
Figure out the hard part later
migrations that polish the easy cases first, or push complexity on callers
Small problem, bigger problem harder
hacky workarounds with hidden dependencies; call it out
It is not a rewrite (but it is)
be honest about how much you will rewrite
Is it operable?
if you struggle at 3 p.m. you will not understand it at 3 a.m.; observable,
debuggable; on-call team of more than three (ideally six)
Bikeshedding
Parkinson's Law of Triviality: long debates on trivial reversible decisions,
silence on the hard ones
